description: Connect your ActiveLayer account to review recent spam checks, inspect submitted fields, verdicts, overall scores and feedback, and see your plan allowance and usage. Detection details can include submitted messages, sender names and email addresses, website URLs, and IP addresses. Internal detection signals, weights, and scoring breakdowns are not returned. Test a sample message with the detector, correct a false positive or false negative, or create a project for a WordPress site or custom application and follow its setup instructions. Feedback replaces any earlier feedback for the selected detection. API keys are generated in your ActiveLayer dashboard and copied directly into your site configuration, never into chat. An ActiveLayer account is required. Demo checks send the supplied fields to ActiveLayer's detection service, are limited to 30 per account per hour, and do not use your account's check allowance or appear in its detection history. A demo result does not verify that your website integration is installed or working.
